item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong tomorrow morning. The weather will become appreciably cooler with one or two rain patches over the region. The associated dry northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the following couple of days. It will be brighter over the region. It will be cold in the morning over inland areas. Under the influence of a fresh easterly airstream, it will become cloudier over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will remain cool in the morning. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China over the weekend.
